facts: Ground vibration tests vertical/undeformed and horizontal/deformed.
Horizontal wing deformed under its own weight.
MODE uses previously computed nonlinear OPER point, otherwise unloaded zero-lift geometry.
Eigenvalue real component is growth/decay, imaginary component is frequency.
N/NN request count and shift; selection depends on distance to shift.
Exactly zero complete scaled physical Weight fields certify inactivity without deleting source records.
Euler chart singularity occurs for span aligned with body x, not either literal y/z ST2 span.
Fixed vacuum/still-air accept condition=None and a stationary fixed frame, with loaded equilibrium construction.
SourceMovingNetwork supports additional moving/free/mixed states, but original mounted stationary setup provides no reason to add them.

obsolete_blocker.affected: The two modal models and their model-inventory rows only.
obsolete_blocker.reason: Both .558 Weight rows have Mg=0 and all optional physical fields omitted/zero. Current exact-null elimination preserves those records and removes no mechanical load or inertia. Modal sensor triads are already valid; partial-sensor support is not needed here.
obsolete_blocker.unchanged: Active static bench Weight objects remain outside-domain errors; workbook producer pairing remains unresolved.

operators.name: drela-fixed-vacuum-v1
operators.settings: condition=None; frame=fixed; stationary rates/accelerations/velocity; literal original model; explicit body gravity [0,0,-9.81]; drela-segspl-v1
operators.qualification: Air-free medium is a prospective reconstruction, not recovered MODE F state.

operators.name: drela-fixed-still-air-v1
operators.settings: Same literal model, fixed frame and gravity; condition=None; quiescent_density=1.23; vacuum=False
operators.qualification: Positive density is a declared sea-level reconstruction. Thin-strip apparent inertia only; no circulatory mean flow.

operators.name: drela-moving-vacuum-v1
operators.settings: Stationary fixed-frame subcase can express same mounted vacuum setup.
operators.qualification: No archived evidence calls for free/mixed/prescribed frame perturbations or nonzero motion; adding them would change the modal problem. Prefer smaller fixed policy.

unknown_setup: No retained modal command script, saved OPER state, eigenvectors or transcript in either modal tree: the two .e00 basenames/titles are matching candidates, not a proven generating-byte transaction.
Vacuum toggle versus still-air added inertia is not recovered. File rho_SL=1.23 is known; actual air density/altitude is not. Do not select the medium by whichever matches best.

Report says forty structural nodes; exact node coordinates, node-generation menu settings and sided sampling are not retained. Current nominal interval count is not identical to historical node count.

The horizontal case is explicitly deformed under its own weight. The upright case is called undeformed because of its vertical orientation, not because gravity is documented as disabled. Exact modal base, OPER constraints, gravity override and attitude are absent.

No retained MODE N count/shift, eigenvector labels or eigenpair pairing. Preserve all seven positive-imaginary complex roots per export, including tiny nonzero real parts. No frequency-only substitution or zero-snapping.
Historical executable/build, startup files and endpoint discretization are not pinned; source-operator verification does not establish historical executable parity.

prospective_meshes.qualification: Predicted by grid recipe and literal breakpoints; not evaluated here and not asserted as original 40-node arrays.

proposed_execution.gravity: Use literal9.81 and explicit body−z for both with zero aircraft attitude/motion; solve the stationary loaded equilibrium. Do not force vertical gravity off or horizontal jig state.

scope_options.name: vacuum plus independently declared still-air conditional branch

proposed_execution.root_selection: Declare a complete search range before comparison; retain every computed root and both conjugates. Match seven positive-imaginary roots per export by an explicit ordered spectral rule or reported permutation, never prune targets or infer physical labels from conflicting workbook columns. Report extra/missing roots, complex residuals and branch ambiguity.
required_checks: Literal source/kernel/helper pins and exact parsed/serialized original records.
Mandatory clamp/sensor/property-break nodes and inactive original null Weight records.
Cold stationary equilibrium and a fresh restored residual with physical force/moment balances.
Full A/M descriptor and left/right original-pencil eigenpair backward errors; preserve near-zero real parts.
All28 native component half-last-place gates unchanged, physical checks distinct from reference agreement.
Predeclared mesh and step/rank/nearby-shift checks with failures retained; no selecting medium/base/mesh by agreement.
proposed_execution.next_action: Update only obsolete modal attachment status; add a bounded literal parse/mesh/operator preflight, then source-only plan preserving all28 cells. Any worker remains explicitly conditional on unrecovered medium/base/nodes.

historical_comparison_scope: scripts/isae_st2.py:67-78 removes null rows; verify-isae-st2-modes.py uses default midpoint/natural model route and selected frequencies/shape matching. Those saved results are historical reconstructions, not unchanged-file source-operator replay.
